statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31, US military forces conduct at least one strike on a target located on Iranian land territory, including Iranian islands.
resolution: YES if the Pentagon, CENTCOM or the White House confirms, or Reuters and AP both report, a US strike on a target on Iranian land territory or islands occurring between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No US strike hits a target on Iranian land territory or Iranian islands between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-22, a Ukrainian drone or missile strike causes fire or damage at an oil refinery, oil terminal or fuel depot in St Petersburg city or Leningrad Oblast.
resolution: YES if Reuters or AP, citing Russian regional or Ukrainian officials, reports a Ukrainian strike causing fire or damage at an oil refinery, oil terminal or fuel depot in St Petersburg or Leningrad Oblast between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-22.
failure_condition: No Ukrainian strike causes fire or damage at any oil refinery, oil terminal or fuel depot in St Petersburg or Leningrad Oblast between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-22.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class

statement: At the FOMC meeting concluding on 2026-10-28, the Federal Reserve raises the federal funds target range. Reference: target range upper bound 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: YES if FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-10-29 is higher than its value for 2026-10-27, reflecting a target-range increase announced at the meeting concluding 2026-10-28.
failure_condition: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged or lowers it at the meeting concluding 2026-10-28.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield prints at or above 5.50 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 5.10 percent on the packet date.

failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield stays below 5.50 percent on every trading day from 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-30.
